Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: No comprehensive national digital ID system documented. Guinea has a biometric ID system but integration with government services through a data exchange is not documented. The World Bank DE4A 2021 recommended ensuring interoperability between foundational ID and social registry as a medium-term priority. ANDE is responsible for state digitalization which includes ID integration planning.

Definition: Integration of learner records, academic credentials, enrollment data, and scholarship/bursary systems
Comments: e-Learning platform launched by PM in April 2024. Univ Connect project interconnected universities, reaching 80,000+ students, lecturers, researchers; GIGA program connected 585 schools to internet. However, integration of education records/credentials with a data exchange layer is not documented. Educational connectivity is operational but data exchange integration is planned.

Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: Guinea is preparing a national instant and interoperable payment system (SPI) based on Mojaloop technology (stakeholder workshop Dec 2025). The system is being designed to ensure full interoperability between payment service providers. Currently no operational government data exchange for G2P/G2B payments. Previously the World Bank DE4A noted an interoperability payment platform under development in 2021.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: A new data protection law is under adoption (2025). ANDE established by decree to lead state digitalization. ANSSI established for cybersecurity. No specific data exchange/interoperability law found. World Bank DE4A 2021 noted lack of e-transactions, e-payments legal framework as a gap. Data protection bill not yet enacted as of late 2025.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: No detailed implementation roadmap for a national data exchange system found. The Simandou 2040 Pillar 3 provides broad direction but lacks a phased interoperability roadmap. World Bank DE4A 2021 recommended inventorying existing information systems as a first quick-win step before building an interoperability roadmap. Instant payment system (SPI) has a roadmap (Mojaloop-based, workshop Dec 2025) but this is specific to payments only.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Guinea's Simandou 2040 program identifies technology/ICT as one of 5 pillars; Pillar 3 (officially launched Nov 2025) addresses infrastructure, transport, and technology including data sovereignty and interoperability. ANDE (Agence Nationale de Digitalisation de l'Etat) established to lead state digitalization. No comprehensive standalone data exchange interoperability strategy found; data exchange is mentioned within broader DPI/digital strategy. World Bank DE4A 2021 report recommended interoperability as a priority.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Guinea has no unified national data exchange hub. Several distinct digital systems are operational: TELEMO (national e-procurement and administrative services platform, launched Nov 2025, born from Guinea-Rwanda partnership); FUGAS (unified civil service registry, operational - saved $26.9M in budget savings in 2025); national e-GOV portal centralizes access to public digital services; 39 public service applications deployed in 2025 including full digitization of passport issuance. Systems are sector-specific and not interconnected through a shared exchange layer.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Internet penetration is 26.5% (Jan 2025). Digital services are primarily urban/Conakry-based. Programs like '200 Femmes dans les TIC' and youth hackathons address inclusion at margins. ANSUTEN (universal service) established. 2026 targets include connecting 2,200 schools. Current data exchange services are very limited in accessibility for most citizens.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Guinea commissioned its first Tier 3-certified national data center in 2025 and secured sovereign management of the .gn domain. A new data protection law is under adoption. ANSSI (cybersecurity) established. Pillar 3 of Simandou 2040 explicitly addresses data and network sovereignty. Data localization is a priority but legal enforcement framework is still being established.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: Digital services are primarily centralized nationally. All 12 administrative regions are now connected via the 12,000km fiber network, and 20 regional digital hubs are under construction (6 operational). However, sub-national participation in any data exchange system is not documented as systems are national-level and largely centralized.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Despite 12,000km fiber network deployment, >600 'white zones' (underserved areas) remain a priority for 2026. Digital hubs are primarily in urban areas (6 operational, 20 under construction). Mobile penetration is high (~95%) but primarily 3G/4G for mobile internet; data exchange and digital government services remain primarily urban.
